overall_goal: Perform various preparatory tasks including gathering ingredients, weighing, note-taking, and organizing the workspace

goals.description: Gather ingredients and search for preparation tools
goals.rationale: The person brings ingredients to the front of the counter and searches through drawers and the dishwasher for a peeler and a suitable knife.

goals.description: Set up the digital scale and weigh sweet potatoes
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the digital scale, turns it on, and prepares to weigh the sweet potatoes by adjusting the scale's settings.

goals.description: Transfer sweet potatoes between the bowl and baking tray
goals.rationale: The person pours sweet potato chunks onto a baking tray and then scoops them back into the bowl.

goals.description: Retrieve oil, nuts, spices, and manage measuring utensils
goals.rationale: The person gathers various ingredients like oil, nuts, and spices from drawers, and handles measuring spoons to ensure all ingredients are properly transferred.

goals.description: Read the recipe and make notes
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly reads the recipe, makes notes on a piece of paper, and fixes a broken pen to continue writing.

goals.description: Put away the oil and spice jars
goals.rationale: The person secures the lids on the spice jars and returns them, along with the oil bottle, to their respective drawers.
The person takes the blender parts out of the cupboard, plugs the base into a power outlet, and assembles the canister on top.

goals.description: Clear the chopping board and prepare the avocado
goals.rationale: The person pushes debris aside to make room on the chopping board, opens the avocado packaging, and transfers the avocado into the blender canister.

goals.description: Operate the weighing scales and handle ingredients
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly presses buttons on the digital scales to zero the weight, moves packaging out of the way, and weighs a clove of garlic.

goals.description: Retrieve a large bowl, tins of ingredients, and clean up sweetcorn
goals.rationale: The person searches cupboards and the fridge to retrieve a large bowl and tins of beans and sweetcorn, then cleans up spilled sweetcorn.

goals.description: Continue reading the recipe and making notes
goals.rationale: The person continues to consult the recipe and write down notes on the piece of paper.
